title: Lightly Crisped Crunchy Australian Corn Paella
description: Satisfy your Australian cravings with this one-pot dish that combines crispy corn flour crust with fresh corn and spices.
instructions: Roll out the lamination puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry into a 9-inch claypot, trimming the edges to fit.
In a large bowl, mix together the diced onion, minced garlic, corn kernels, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes.
Pour the oil into the claypot and add the onion mixture, spreading it evenly.
Place the claypot in the oven and bake for 20 minutes.
After 20 minutes, remove the claypot from the oven and roll out the remaining puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a pastry cutter or a knife to cut the pastry into thin strips.
Place the pastry strips on top of the corn mixture in a woven pattern.
Return the claypot to the oven and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle chopped parsley on top of the paella and serve warm.
